newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Central Bank active in peso market.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Central Bank active in peso market.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank continued to intervene on Friday in what is the most heavily traded day on record in the Manila currency market, after raising its overnight borrowing rate to 20 from 13 percent, traders said.
Traders said the Central Bank has been buying dollars at 26.356/26.357 for delivery today and at 26.371/26.372 for delivery on Monday.
At the same time, it was also selling dollars at 26.375, one said.
Turnover in the foreign exchange market has already swelled to a record $613 million late on Friday.
It surpassed the previous $446.3-million volume on January 9 when the peso was hit from the sharp fall in interest rates after a reserve requirement cut.

The peso has been reeling from the spillover effects of the problems of the Thai baht. This has forced the Central Bank to raise its key overnight borrowing rate by 8.75 percentage points in two days.
